nodes.label: Digital Compositing
nodes.description: The process of joining multiple digital image layers into a single seamless virtual space.

nodes.label: Aesthetics of Continuity
nodes.description: An anti-montage aesthetics in new media where boundaries between elements are erased to simulate a continuous human experience.

nodes.label: Montage
nodes.description: A technique aiming to create visual, stylistic, semantic, and emotional dissonance by juxtaposing elements.

nodes.label: Montage within a shot (Spatial Montage)
nodes.description: Combining separate realities into contingent parts of a single image, making space as important as time.

nodes.label: Teleaction (Telepresence)
nodes.description: The ability to manipulate physical reality over a distance in real time through electronic transmission.

nodes.label: Image-Instruments
nodes.description: Representations (like perspective, radar, or real-time video) that systematically capture reality to act upon it.

nodes.label: Big Optics
nodes.description: Paul Virilio's concept of real-time electronic transmission that collapses physical distance.

nodes.label: Small Optics
nodes.description: Geometric perspective and human vision which maintain a natural spatial distance.
